title: Economist Steve Hanke Says His Best Investment Is a Swiss Watch
summary:
A pocket watch and a parcel of farmland.
Veteran trader Steve Hanke counts those two items among the best investments and biggest misses of his life.
The hitsAt age 16, Hanke purchased a Patek Philippe pocket watch for $90 at an auction in Omaha.
Hanke now only wears the watch on special occasions, but "the rest of the time I admire it," he said.
The lessonHanke's pocket watch showcases the value of a storied brand, a good deal, a decadeslong holding period, and a beautiful object that can be worn and admired.

title: 10 challenges facing the real estate industry in 2026, according to young leaders
summary:
The real estate market has felt anything but normal in 2026.
But Business Insider's 2026 Rising Stars of Real Estate say it's not all doom and gloom.
Some rising stars see a bigger role for agents as buyers and sellers try to make sense of a complicated market.
And in some markets, like Miami and New York, they say demand is picking up again.
Here are what 10 of this year's rising stars say are the biggest issues facing real estate and how they think the industry will adapt.

title: RBI may hike repo rate by 25-50 bps in December as inflation breaches 6%: Experts
summary:
SynopsisIndia's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper limit.
Experts anticipate that the RBI may hike the repo rate by 25 to 50 basis points in December.
Persistent food inflation has raised concerns over price stability and household purchasing power.
Market analysts suggest that a rate hike could influence borrowing costs and economic growth.

title: Siege on Hebron’s Beit Ula industrial zone threatens Palestinian economy
summary:

title: Defeating Volatility: Market wealth at 10-month peak on peppy sentiment
summary:
SynopsisIndia's global market capitalisation has seen a remarkable upswing since October, adding about $500 billion and reaching close to $5.42 trillion.
This rebound has enabled India to reclaim its fifth-place ranking in the world.
The return of foreign investors, after a substantial sell-off in AI stocks, is a testament to India's recovery against the backdrop of ongoing economic and market turbulence.
